prompt: What issue does the woman mention at the beginning?
promptZh: 女方一開始提到什麼問題？

options.whyZh: 標籤是稍後拍照時要入鏡的資料，不是最先提到的問題。

options.zh: 其中一片飾板看起來霧霧的。
options.whyZh: 女方指出檢驗燈下左邊的飾板看起來霧霧的。

options.text: An inspection lamp has stopped working.
options.whyZh: 兩人用燈照飾板，沒有提到燈故障。

options.text: Two panels were sent to the wrong address.
options.whyZh: 女方比較同批飾板的外觀，未提送錯地點。

explanationZh: 女方指出檢驗燈下左邊的飾板看起來霧霧的。
evidence: Two trim panels from this shipment look different under the inspection lamp. The one on the left looks cloudy. Do we need to send the whole shipment back?
